text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a research study focused on assessing potentials of renewable energy sources in Germany using land-use datasets, 3D building data, and land eligibility analyses. It does not implement or compare future LULC scenarios quantitatively, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections. The study uses land use datasets as inputs to estimate renewable energy potentials but does not predict or model future LULC changes. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction and is excluded.)
